title: Emergency LPOA Revocation Mid-Trade: Market Close Option
precondition: Investor decides to exit MAM immediately while holding 2 open positions.
steps: 1. Click 'Emergency Disconnect'.2. Select 'Close all positions at market'.
expected_result: Sizing engine immediately closes investor's 2 child positions at market; LPOA unlinked; net cash freed.
actual_result: Emergency disconnect with market close liquidates investor child positions at live market price and revokes LPOA.
